scheme_name: Laxman Award / Rani Laxmi Bai Award Scheme
other_conditions: The sportsperson must be a bonafide native of Uttar Pradesh
Must have been a member of the state senior team for at least three consecutive years (e.g., 2018‑19, 2019‑20, 2020‑21)
Must have participated in the National Games or National Senior Championship and have won a medal in the award year

Participation in any listed international competitions (Olympic Games, World Championship/World Cup, Asian Games, Commonwealth Games, Asian Championship, Commonwealth Championship, SAF Games) makes the candidate eligible
Must submit an affidavit affirming no consumption of prohibited drugs in any competition
Must submit an oath confirming no criminal conviction or involvement in sexual harassment cases
Only one award can be given to a person and the award is not repeatable
Players who have only participated in National Senior Championships/National Games without international exposure are ineligible
benefits_summary: Recipients receive a citation, a bronze statue, a scroll, and a cash prize of ₹311,000.
documents_required: Oath confirming no criminal or sexual harassment convictions
